terra.problem: The text does not mention an empty cup table.
“Peter's name just isn't on this card” refers to the card itself, which Papa Dorin does not do.
The passage does not say whether Nathanael spoke at the wedding; it simply does not record him speaking.
Saying he would have been hiding behind the punch table puts Papa Dorin in the Bible event.
The text does not establish that nobody asked for water at the wedding.
The text does not say how many trips filling the jars took.
The text does not say the servants were standing there or that what they knew was a secret.
The text does not mention a cup or say the servants saw everything, including the transformation.
The text does not say the servants poured the water.
The text does not say the guests were enjoying the party.
The text says the disciples believed, but it does not say they saw the sign.
“Right after” adds timing the text does not give for the disciples' belief.
